items.title: AfD’s Far Right Win Puts New Pressure on Germany’s Leader Merz
items.summary: Antipathy to Chancellor Friedrich Merz was a reason the far right surged in a state election. Though he does not face a national election until 2029, his leadership is under increasing scrutiny.
